purpose: Canonical product-model inventory. This records product contracts, not proof that a particular user run produced every artifact.

artifact_kinds.label: Game Blueprint
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Blueprint metadata plus source file path; generated reel strips are materialized before dependent builds. Studio symbolArtwork entries are project-relative references to separate Studio Symbol Artwork PNG companions, never embedded pixels or picker paths.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Source-of-truth design. Editing invalidates derived outputs; a fresh validation is required before dependent materialization. A missing optional symbol-artwork companion must not make the design model invalid or authorize arbitrary file serving.

artifact_kinds.label: Studio Symbol Artwork PNG
artifact_kinds.shape: separate durable project-relative PNG file at assets/symbols/<sanitized-name>-<unique>.png; the Blueprint contains only its relative reference
recognized_by: studio:player CanonicalPlayerView (Studio adapter resolves declared references and supplies URLs)
cli:client player renderPlayer artworkUrlForSymbol callback (shared renderer; no endpoint or declared-reference consumer)
artifact_kinds.provenance: The user-selected source PNG is copied to a temporary Studio staging location. The editor writes only an assets/symbols/... reference in Blueprint.symbolArtwork; save()/saveManaged() copies the staged bytes beside the Blueprint, so picker paths and image bytes are not embedded in Blueprint JSON.
artifact_kinds.stale: The staged source is session-local. If it disappears before a save, the Blueprint reference can persist without a file; after a project is moved or files are manually removed/corrupted, the reference remains historical but no longer resolves to artwork.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Optional presentation companion, not a game-model input. Only a declared Blueprint reference beginning assets/symbols/, remaining inside the Blueprint directory, resolving to a regular PNG at most 5 MB is served. Editor and player retain the symbol-id fallback when it is absent, unsafe, stale or unreadable.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Re-import a valid PNG in the Symbols editor and save the Blueprint again, or remove the stale symbolArtwork reference. /api/project/symbol-artwork returns only declared references and returns 404 for missing, undeclared or invalid files; it never browses arbitrary project paths.

artifact_kinds.label: POKIE TypeScript game package
artifact_kinds.shape: directory with package.json/pokie.entry
artifact_kinds.provenance: Package manifest and generated source retain game identity/version; a materialized Blueprint package is an implementation artifact, not a new editable Blueprint.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Runnable only when the package loader accepts its entry and dependencies. It may generate an Outcome Library only when exact enumeration is implemented.

artifact_kinds.label: Verified Blueprint runtime materialization cache
artifact_kinds.shape: machine-local temporary cache directory `<tmp>/pokie-materialize-cache/<content-addressed-key>` containing a generated, dependency-installed and verified TypeScript runtime; never a user-owned Blueprint/package output
artifact_kinds.provenance: Its cache key hashes the exact Blueprint content, POKIE version, Blueprint schema/build-contract version and runtime installation identity. It is a disposable verified runtime borrow, not a new editable source, artifact target, or a directory the author should move/share.
artifact_kinds.stale: An edit, POKIE/version/build-contract/runtime-identity change selects a new key; marker-less or marker-mismatched entries are stale and are never served. A completed ready entry is reused unchanged, while a failed/cancelled staging directory is cleaned up and a later request retries.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only a Blueprint with build capability is materialized; an already runnable tsPackage passes through. A cache entry is usable only after generation, dependency installation and package validation complete and its readiness marker matches the computed key.
artifact_kinds.containment: The cache root is deliberately outside the Blueprint directory and caller cwd, under the OS temporary directory. Staging is a unique sibling and is atomically renamed only after readiness; callers receive the runtime path through the resolver and must release it, never treat it as a project destination.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Blueprint validation, generation, dependency-install and verify failures preserve their materialization phase through BlueprintMaterializationError. Unsupported recognized project types receive the shared capability diagnostic rather than a cache-path/parser failure.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Correct the Blueprint or runtime dependency failure and retry the same public action; stale/incomplete entries are evicted under the per-key lock and rebuilt. A valid ready cache is reused automatically, while an intentionally changed source obtains a fresh key.

artifact_kinds.label: Blueprint runtime readiness marker
artifact_kinds.shape: internal `.pokie-materialized.json` file in a cache entry containing the expected cacheKey
artifact_kinds.provenance: It certifies only that this content-addressed cache directory completed this materializer's phases; package.json or pokie.entry alone is deliberately insufficient because they appear before dependency installation and verification.
artifact_kinds.stale: Missing, malformed or mismatched cacheKey markers make the containing cache stale. They are discarded/rebuilt rather than upgraded in place or exposed as a partial runtime.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Internal implementation marker only; it has no public import/export/replay meaning and is valid solely with its matching cache directory and computed key.
artifact_kinds.containment: Written only into the private staging/cache directory before the atomic cache-directory rename; it is never written beside a user Blueprint or exposed as a user-selectable input.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Readiness failure is intentionally recovered as stale cache rebuild; materialization phase errors remain the user-facing diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Do not edit or copy the marker. Retry the runtime action so the materializer removes an incomplete entry under lock and publishes a freshly verified pair.

artifact_kinds.label: WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON
artifact_kinds.shape: single JSON file containing one raw WeightedOutcomeLibrary
artifact_kinds.provenance: The generator records library id, schema version, outcomes and generation diagnostics in the command result; the persisted file is the raw library value, not a bundle manifest or an assertion that it has passed bundle validation.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is derived from the exact package/runtime and generation options used for the sweep. A changed package, mode, stake, enumeration strategy or sampled seed makes the file stale for a claimed current model and requires regeneration.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: It is accepted only where a WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON input is explicitly supported. It cannot be sampled, served, replayed as a native source or treated as a canonical Outcome Library directory until a subsequent bundle materialization succeeds.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the raw JSON, create an Outcome Library descriptor that names it, then run `pokie export <config.json> --to outcomes --out <dir>`; that public route delegates to `pokie outcomelibrary build`. Regenerate from the package when its provenance is stale or the JSON is invalid.

artifact_kinds.label: Outcome Library bundle descriptor
artifact_kinds.shape: durable user-authored JSON config with modes[].modeName and exactly one of libraryPath (WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON) or outcomesPath (canonical outcome JSONL); outcomesPath also requires libraryId and may declare schemaVersion
created_by: user-authored Outcome Library bundle config (POKIE does not create this descriptor)
artifact_kinds.provenance: The descriptor is the durable handoff from user-selected raw source files to a bundle: each relative source path is resolved against the descriptor directory. It carries mode names and streaming-source library identity rather than inventing raw-library provenance; POKIE-created raw generation JSON is only one supported source form.
artifact_kinds.stale: It becomes stale for a current-model claim when a named raw library or outcomes JSONL source is replaced, moved, corrupted, or has incompatible cross-mode provenance. The descriptor itself does not freeze bytes or hashes, so rebuilding rereads its current named sources.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: OutcomeLibraryCommand accepts one source form per mode: libraryPath for one WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON value, or outcomesPath for canonical JSONL plus libraryId and optional schemaVersion. Raw JSON and streaming JSONL are materialization inputs, not a native bundle, and must pass bundle/provenance validation together.
artifact_kinds.containment: Source paths are resolved with path.resolve from the descriptor directory for reading; this contract does not claim project-directory containment or rewrite source paths. Destination safety is separately enforced by the bundle writer/export destination checks.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Malformed descriptors name the config path, modes[] entry, missing modeName, mutually exclusive source requirement, or missing outcomesPath libraryId and include the outcome-library config hint. ExportCommand translates an incompatible descriptor into the target-oriented outcomes recovery diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair the named mode entry or point it at retained compatible raw JSON/JSONL, then run `pokie export <config.json> --to outcomes --out <dir>` (or the delegated build). Regenerate raw sources when provenance is stale; choose a new safe destination when publication is refused.

artifact_kinds.label: Canonical streamed outcome JSONL
artifact_kinds.shape: newline-delimited canonical outcome records supplied as a durable JSONL file; this is a mode source, not an Outcome Library directory or manifest
created_by: OutcomeLibraryBundleWriter per-mode JSONL when a native bundle is later materialized
artifact_kinds.provenance: The descriptor supplies libraryId and optional schemaVersion because JSONL records alone are streamed rather than a self-describing WeightedOutcomeLibrary value. POKIE recognizes the named file as a durable user/external source; a bundle writer's per-mode JSONL is internal content of a later native bundle, not proof that an arbitrary JSONL already is one.
artifact_kinds.stale: The stream is stale for a current-library claim when its producer, records, library identity, schema version or cross-mode provenance changes, or when it is moved, truncated or corrupted. Materialization rereads the named stream and never reuses an earlier in-memory result as current input.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only OutcomeLibraryCommand's outcomesPath descriptor form accepts it, with exactly one source form per mode plus libraryId and optional numeric schemaVersion. Parsed records must satisfy the weighted-library and bundle writer provenance contracts before a native Outcome Library is published.
artifact_kinds.containment: outcomesPath is resolved with path.resolve from the descriptor directory for read-only access. It is intentionally not claimed to be project-contained; create-only/atomic bundle destination safety is enforced separately.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: A malformed descriptor identifies modes[] and the missing outcomesPath libraryId; unreadable/invalid JSONL or incompatible provenance fails the Outcome Library source contract, while ExportCommand presents the target-oriented outcomes recovery diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair or restore the JSONL and descriptor identity fields, then rerun `pokie export <config.json> --to outcomes --out <dir>` (or delegated build). Regenerate/re-export the stream if its source provenance is stale; do not sample, serve or replay the JSONL directly.

artifact_kinds.label: ExactEnumerationCheckpoint
artifact_kinds.shape: single JSON resume checkpoint with bigint values encoded as decimal strings
artifact_kinds.provenance: Captures processed raw index, total, source enumeration identity and accumulated weighted grids from one interrupted generation run; it contains progress, not a usable library.
artifact_kinds.stale: A successful resumed generation removes the checkpoint. It is valid only for the exact same compatible enumeration/options; changing the package or generation contract requires discarding it and starting a new sweep.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only `--resume` accepts this serialized checkpoint. A malformed checkpoint or one incompatible with the generator's source enumeration fails rather than being silently adapted.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Re-run the same generate command with `--resume <file>`; if the source or options changed, retain it only for audit and regenerate without resume. A cancellation without `--resume` has no persisted recovery state.

artifact_kinds.label: Outcome Library bundle
artifact_kinds.shape: directory: manifest, per-mode index and JSONL outcomes
artifact_kinds.provenance: Manifest records library identity/hash and outcome provenance. CLI raw generation must be materialized from WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON through a descriptor before this bundle exists; Studio Generate performs those two stages together. Blueprint/package-derived libraries can be managed prerequisite projects.
artifact_kinds.stale: Editing or regenerating a contributing Blueprint/package/raw library makes a previously built bundle stale for claims about the current source; rebuild and deep-validate before downstream use.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Native sampling contract required for sampling, serving, simulation and exact replay. Hash/mode identity must match replay, fairness and certification consumers.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Use the retained raw WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON and an Outcome Library descriptor to rebuild an unavailable or stale bundle; do not substitute the raw file itself for a bundle directory.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake Engine export descriptor
artifact_kinds.shape: durable user-authored JSON config with modes[].modeName, numeric cost, and exactly one of libraryPath (WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON) or bundleDir (Outcome Library bundle); bundleDir may set bundleModeName
created_by: user-authored Stake Engine export config (POKIE does not create the generic descriptor)
artifact_kinds.provenance: The descriptor preserves user-selected mode names and costs and resolves each relative libraryPath/bundleDir from the descriptor directory. A POKIE Stake import can create stakeImportReExportConfig as one re-export-ready bundleDir specialization, but that companion is not the generic contract and does not describe all supported source forms.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is stale when its named raw library/bundle, selected bundle mode, costs, or source provenance no longer matches the intended export. It is a live path-based prerequisite, not a snapshot; rerunning rereads the current sources.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Every mode needs a string modeName, numeric cost, and exactly one libraryPath or bundleDir. libraryPath loads raw WeightedOutcomeLibrary JSON; bundleDir loads the selected bundleModeName or defaults it to modeName. The resolved modes must satisfy StakeEngineExportValidator before a target export is promised.
artifact_kinds.containment: Source paths are resolved with path.resolve from the descriptor directory for read-only loading; no project-root containment guarantee is implied. Output publication remains subject to create-only destination checks and atomic writer behavior.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Unreadable config, malformed modes, missing cost, invalid source alternatives, and bad bundle/library inputs are reported as Stake Engine export config/source failures with the config hint. ExportCommand maps delegated failure to its target-oriented adapter recovery message.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair the config's mode source/cost, restore or rebuild its raw library/bundle, and rerun `pokie export <config.json> --to adapter --out <dir>` (or delegated stakeengine export). Use a different unused destination when output safety rejects publication.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake Engine export
artifact_kinds.shape: directory: pokie-manifest.json, index.json, lookup CSV and compressed JSONL books
artifact_kinds.provenance: pokie-manifest.json identifies POKIE-produced exports. Generic Stake analysis does not require that manifest.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Read-only as an outcome source: it can be analyzed/diffed and re-exported, but it cannot be sampled, simulated, replayed or served until imported to a native Outcome Library.

artifact_kinds.label: PAR workbook
artifact_kinds.shape: XLSX file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Deterministic Blueprint snapshot; import records its workbook origin in the resulting managed Blueprint registration.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Exchange-only. A workbook must be imported to a Blueprint before build, validation, simulation or runtime use.

artifact_kinds.label: POKIE WASM component
artifact_kinds.shape: WASM binary with compatible sidecar manifest
artifact_kinds.provenance: Sidecar manifest declares contract, serialization and host-binding compatibility.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Inspection-only boundary. POKIE has no WASM producer, runtime execution backend, game-logic validation or package-to-WASM compiler.

artifact_kinds.label: RoundArtifact
artifact_kinds.shape: portable canonical JSON record of one completed round
artifact_kinds.provenance: The canonical/audit-grade completed-round record retains game and POKIE identity, with source-specific state and selection provenance.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A malformed or incompatible artifact is inspectable only as failed input; exact reproduction additionally requires the matching source identity.

artifact_kinds.label: Runtime play session
artifact_kinds.shape: live process-local server session; the default InMemorySessionRepository keeps only serializable state in a process-lifetime Map
artifact_kinds.provenance: The default session is process-local and is not a portable project, replay, or audit artifact; recording a completed round emits a separately inventoried RoundArtifact. An embedding server may opt into FileSessionRepository, whose separate record is a server-state snapshot rather than this live object.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Live-package replay is best effort; outcome-library replay carries a portable exact identity. The default InMemorySessionRepository state is lost on restart; FileSessionRepository has distinct versioned/raw compatibility and restart semantics.

artifact_kinds.label: FileSessionRepository session-state record
artifact_kinds.shape: one JSON file per server session at `<configured-directory>/<sha256(sessionId)>.json`, normally a `{version, state}` envelope containing serializable PokieSessionState; it is durable server state, not a project artifact, replay descriptor, round record, or wallet ledger
recognized_by: SpinCommandHandler cache-miss session reconstruction after restart
artifact_kinds.provenance: POST /sessions captures initial PokieSessionState and every committed spin captures the latest state through the configured repository. The record deliberately excludes credits, which remain WalletPort state; serializer/debug payload is present only according to PokieDevServer capture policy. Each successful save increments the per-session version. A legacy raw PokieSessionState file is read as version 0 and the next save upgrades it to the envelope.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is live mutable server state, not a frozen source claim. A record can become stale relative to a restarted process's in-memory wallet/idempotency state because those defaults reset independently; editing/moving files is unsupported. Missing, malformed or unparsable JSON is treated as absent rather than repaired in place.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The public SessionRepository base remains the unversioned save/load pair; FileSessionRepository additionally implements VersionedSessionRepository. Envelope records require numeric version plus state; pre-version raw state is backward-compatible as version 0. A cache miss reconstructs a session from persisted context/bet and optional featureState, while unsupported hidden runtime/RNG state begins fresh.
artifact_kinds.containment: The embedding application owns the configured directory. FileSessionRepository derives a lowercase SHA-256 filename from the untrusted sessionId and joins only `<hash>.json` below that directory, so URL session ids cannot select or traverse arbitrary paths; it creates that directory recursively on save.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Missing or corrupt records deliberately become undefined at repository level; PokieDevServer maps the resulting GET/cache-miss state to the normal unknown-session 404 rather than a server crash. Version conflicts surface as SessionVersionConflictError/HTTP 409 through the versioned spin path, not as a replay or project diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.recovery: For a missing/corrupt record, create a new session; retain or repair bytes externally only if the deployment owns that operational recovery. Reconstruct a new FileSessionRepository against the same configured directory to restore a valid record after server restart. Deployments needing durable credits, idempotency or cross-process atomicity must supply those dependencies/locking themselves.

artifact_kinds.label: Simulation report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON report; optional rendered Markdown or HTML report
artifact_kinds.provenance: Must retain source type, seed where supplied, settings and completed result identity; `report --format json --out` may make a presentation copy of this same result. A report is analysis output, not a playable project.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical when its package/library source, simulation settings, seed or runtime version no longer match the claimed run; a JSON rendering inherits the same staleness.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Outcome-library simulations are exactly replayable only with non-empty seed and matching mode/library hash. Package simulations remain runtime-dependent.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the report and its recorded inputs for audit, then rerun `pokie sim` after a source or settings change; render or diff the new report instead of treating the old result as current.

artifact_kinds.label: Per-mode simulation report set
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON object containing one SimulationReport per declared bet mode
artifact_kinds.provenance: Carries one independently generated SimulationReport for each declared mode; `report --format json --out` may make a presentation copy of this same set. It deliberately has no blended aggregate because POKIE does not know real mode-selection weights.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical when any mode's package/library source, simulation settings, seed or runtime version changes; a JSON rendering inherits the same staleness.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A report set is analysis output only. Consumers must preserve its per-mode identity rather than treating it as one replayable result or a playable project.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the per-mode reports for audit, then rerun `pokie sim --mode all` after source or settings changes; do not replace the set with a blended aggregate.

artifact_kinds.label: ValidateReport
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON validation result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Pins the requested path, resolved project kind, deep flag, validation issues and suggestions from one validation run; it is a result record, not a validated project substitute.
artifact_kinds.stale: It becomes stale whenever the inspected source, validator contract or requested deep-validation scope changes.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The JSON is a public result payload for people and automation; no POKIE command accepts it as a project, report, replay or conversion input.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Keep the report for diagnosis, repair the named source, then rerun `pokie validate` and write a new result file rather than modifying a prior report in place.

artifact_kinds.label: SimulationReportDiff or SimulationReportSetDiff
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON comparison result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records the two supplied simulation report paths and their computed single-mode or per-mode differences; it does not carry a new simulation source or replay identity.
artifact_kinds.stale: A regenerated, moved or replaced input report makes an earlier comparison historical rather than a comparison of the current inputs.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: `pokie diff` requires like-with-like single reports or report sets and does not consume a prior diff as an input report.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Preserve both input reports, then rerun `pokie diff` to a new unused `--out` path after either input changes; create-only publication refuses replacement to retain recoverability.

artifact_kinds.label: OutcomeSourceProjectDiff
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON comparison result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records exact analyses of two resolved native Outcome Library or Stake outcome sources and their computed differences, including each source's read limitations.
artifact_kinds.stale: Any changed, rebuilt or re-imported source invalidates a claim that this is its current comparison.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only analyzable resolved outcome sources participate; this report is not a source project and cannot make a read-only Stake export drawable.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Resolve and repair each named source, then recompute to a new output path; retain the old report only as an audit of its original source state.

artifact_kinds.label: StakeEngineStandaloneAnalysis report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON analysis result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records the supplied Stake directory, read issues and standalone exact analysis when available; it intentionally supports third-party Stake directories that are not POKIE exports.
artifact_kinds.stale: Changing the analyzed directory or repairing its books/index makes the saved analysis historical.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: It is an analysis result only, never an importable Stake directory, native Outcome Library or simulation report.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Use the recorded issues to repair or replace the Stake input, then rerun analyze; `--out` overwrites its requested analysis result through the command's normal write path.

artifact_kinds.label: StakeEngineStandaloneAnalysisDiff report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON comparison result file
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records both supplied Stake directories, each reader's issues and the standalone-analysis difference when both sides are analyzable.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical after either input directory changes, including a regenerated POKIE export.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The result is not a Stake directory or an outcome source; invalid input is represented as issues and no material diff rather than a conversion.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair the named inputs and write a fresh comparison to a new unused path; create-only publication refuses replacement and preserves previous results.

artifact_kinds.label: OutcomeSourceProjectReport
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON, Markdown or HTML analysis rendering
artifact_kinds.provenance: Renders the resolved OutcomeSourceProjectAnalyzer result for one native library or Stake source, including capabilities and analysis limitations, in the selected format.
artifact_kinds.stale: It becomes stale when the source, its bundle hash/books or the analyzer result changes.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Presentation only: it is neither a project source nor a SimulationReport, even when its selected `--format json` is machine-readable.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Inspect/repair the named source and rerun `pokie report` to a safe output path; use the actual source, not this rendering, for sample, diff or conversion.

artifact_kinds.label: Rendered simulation report
artifact_kinds.shape: Markdown or HTML rendering of a SimulationReport or SimulationReportSet
artifact_kinds.provenance: A rendering preserves the source SimulationReport or per-mode SimulationReportSet identity as presented analysis; it is not a source project or replay descriptor.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is historical when its source simulation report or report set is regenerated or replaced.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Readable presentation only; use the source simulation report or report set for comparison or replay provenance.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Regenerate the presentation from the retained simulation report or report set to a safe `--out` path; use the source result rather than its rendering for comparison or replay.

artifact_kinds.label: Replay descriptor
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON descriptor
validates_by: RoundArtifactValidator where recorded result is present
artifact_kinds.provenance: Exact outcome replay pins library id/hash, mode, seed and round. Package replay is explicitly best effort.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reject source/hash/mode mismatch instead of silently replaying a different outcome; the original portable descriptor is required for recovery.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake-import re-export configuration
artifact_kinds.shape: config.json companion in an imported Outcome Library directory
recognized_by: StakeEngineCommand:loadDescriptor as a bundleDir-only re-export specialization
artifact_kinds.provenance: Records imported mode names, costs and the reconstructed bundle selectors so the reconstructed library can be re-exported without guessing configuration. It is POKIE-created output of Stake import, unlike the user-authored generic stakeEngineExportDescriptor.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is stale when the imported bundle directory, selected mode, or source provenance no longer matches the generated re-export selection.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A bundleDir-only POKIE-created specialization of the generic Stake Engine export descriptor, and a companion to—not a replacement for—the canonical Outcome Library manifest/index/outcome files. User-authored generic descriptors may instead use libraryPath.
artifact_kinds.containment: The import writer places it as config.json within its atomically published imported library directory; later export resolves its bundleDir entries relative to that config path and still applies ordinary source/destination validation.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Import reports config.json among its written files; a moved, malformed, or incompatible companion later receives the normal Stake export descriptor/source diagnostic rather than silently guessing a replacement.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Use the retained imported Outcome Library with a repaired user-authored Stake Engine export descriptor, or re-import the valid POKIE Stake directory to recreate this convenience companion.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake-import source provenance
artifact_kinds.shape: optional source-provenance.json companion in an imported Outcome Library directory
artifact_kinds.provenance: When the imported export supplies source provenance, preserves its index, manifest and per-mode source hashes rather than pretending the reconstructed library is the original model.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Optional metadata only: its absence does not make the reconstructed Outcome Library invalid, but it limits source-audit continuity.

artifact_kinds.label: Certification/evidence bundle
artifact_kinds.shape: directory with deterministic metrics, diagnostics and sampled/verifiable RoundArtifacts
artifact_kinds.provenance: Pins game/library hashes, source deep-validation diagnostics, metrics and sampled artifacts.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Verification requires the live source Outcome Library. Studio builds/inspects but does not expose the CLI's external verify operation.

artifact_kinds.label: Certification build descriptor
artifact_kinds.shape: durable user-authored JSON config with modes[].modeName, seed and numeric sampleCount for `certification build <bundleDir> <config.json>`
created_by: user-authored certification build config (POKIE does not create this descriptor)
recognized_by: studio:certification-build request supplies equivalent mode samples
artifact_kinds.provenance: The author chooses the sampled mode names, seeds and counts while the separately supplied native bundle supplies the library identity/hash and outcomes. Relative values are not path-bearing source fields; the config path is reported only as the identity of the user-authored descriptor.
artifact_kinds.stale: It is stale for a current certification claim when its mode/seed/sample policy changes or the named bundle is replaced, moved, corrupt or has different provenance. The descriptor does not snapshot source bytes; each build checks the live bundle before sampling.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: CertificationCommand accepts an object with modes[] entries containing string modeName, string seed and numeric sampleCount, and only builds from a native Outcome Library source. A valid descriptor cannot make a wrong project type or stale bundle certify.
artifact_kinds.containment: The config itself is read exactly from the explicit CLI path; unlike export descriptors it resolves no nested filesystem paths. BundleDir is independently classified by ProjectTargetResolver and output publication uses the certification writer's safe destination rules.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Unreadable/non-object configs and malformed modes identify the config path, modes[] position and certification config hint. A recognized non-library bundle path receives the capability diagnostic; builder validation reports source/build issues without claiming successful evidence.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair modes/seed/sampleCount, restore or rebuild/deep-validate the native bundle, then rerun `pokie certification build <bundleDir> <config.json> [--out <dir>]`. Use a new safe output directory when publication is refused; use `certification verify --source` for an existing bundle.

artifact_kinds.label: FairnessServerSeedCommitment
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON server-seed commitment
artifact_kinds.provenance: The first publishable artifact records only the hash of the still-private server seed and issuance time, before client seed, nonce or outcome-source selection are known. The CLI can persist it with `--out`; Studio's configure response previews the same value together with its later round commitment, but does not durably publish it. Durable publication timing still requires an external log or timestamping authority.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: `fairness commit` accepts only a structurally valid server-seed commitment. It is a prerequisite for a round commitment, never a substitute for one, and it never contains the raw server seed.

artifact_kinds.label: FairnessCommitment
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON round commitment
artifact_kinds.provenance: The later, round-specific artifact carries forward the earlier server-seed hash and pins client seed, nonce, library identity/hash and mode before selection. It does not itself prove that the earlier server-seed commitment was externally published in time.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reveal/verify require the matching round commitment and live bundle; mismatch is a verification failure, never a fallback draw.

artifact_kinds.label: FairnessRoundProof
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON proof
artifact_kinds.provenance: Bound to commitment hash and pinned-snapshot HMAC-SHA256 selection.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A proof only verifies against its matching commitment and source bundle; POKIE does not provide key management, timestamping, wallet or compliance authority.

artifact_kinds.label: External deployment artifact
artifact_kinds.shape: target-defined output
artifact_kinds.provenance: Target descriptor, compatibility/projection/generation/validation stages and optional delivery diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only registered target capabilities are eligible. POKIE ships no private RGS integration; delivery is target-owned.

artifact_kinds.label: Managed Outcome Projects registry
artifact_kinds.shape: durable .pokie/managed-outcome-projects.json metadata document beside a source project; entries hold a canonical Outcome Library rootPath plus game id/version, config hash, POKIE version and generation kind
artifact_kinds.provenance: Each registration records the canonical absolute rootPath of a verified generated bundle together with the exact game identity, configuration hash, POKIE version and exact/direct generation identity. It is durable discovery metadata shared by CLI and Studio, not the bundle or an assertion that the path remains usable.
artifact_kinds.stale: Entries become stale when the bundle is moved, deleted, corrupt, no longer resolves as an Outcome Library, or its manifest differs in game/version/configuration/POKIE version. findCompatible ignores such entries and does not silently reuse them; it may adopt the deterministic legacy root only after verifying it and registering it.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reuse requires exact OutcomeProjectCompatibility, including generation kind. The persisted rootPath is canonicalized on write but is not trusted as a containment or compatibility proof: it is reopened through the manifest reader and resolver before use. A malformed JSON/read failure surfaces rather than being interpreted as a compatible library; a structurally wrong projects value is treated as an empty registry.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Repair or remove a malformed registry document, then rerun the managed build/export path to regenerate or re-register a verified bundle. Missing/stale entries can be left for audit because they are ignored, or refreshed by a successful registerAndOpen; failed registration restores the prior document (or removes a newly created empty one).

artifact_kinds.label: Studio Outcome Library discovery index
artifact_kinds.shape: durable project-scoped .pokie/outcome-library-registry.json JSON array of Studio-generated project-relative bundle-directory names
recognized_by: Studio Outcome Library Registry panel after restart
artifact_kinds.provenance: After Studio has successfully written a bundle, it best-effort appends that requested project-relative output directory to the separate index. It contains directory names only, never outcome data, and lets a fresh Studio service/server discover custom output directories as well as the conventional outcomelibrary directory.
artifact_kinds.stale: A missing directory, blank/absolute/escaping/symlink-escaping/file entry, malformed index or non-array index is dropped or ignored while the conventional outcomelibrary directory is still checked. A safe indexed directory with a corrupt bundle manifest is reported as that bundle's load error, not silently used. A failed index write does not undo the already-successful bundle generation and leaves the bundle discoverable in the current process.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: The index is discovery-only, never bundle truth. Both the index path and every entry must resolve inside the project through realpath-aware containment and entries must be directories; registry() then reads each bundle manifest and labels it compatible, stale or wrong against the current game/configuration/POKIE version.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Regenerate to the desired project-relative directory to record it again, or repair/remove the index and reopen Studio; the default outcomelibrary directory remains discoverable without it. Repair or rebuild an indexed corrupt bundle before it can be listed as usable.

artifact_kinds.label: Studio project registry entry
artifact_kinds.shape: durable app-data `projects.json` JSON array at `PokiePathResolver.resolveAppDataDirectory()/projects.json`, each record holding canonical location, name, type, capabilities, origin, recency and optional PAR provenance; it is not a project artifact
artifact_kinds.provenance: The writer persists Studio's local registration intent: resolved canonical location, origin (managed/external), display name, type/capabilities at registration time, lastOpenedAt and optional PAR import provenance. It survives a Studio restart but is not an interchange format, source copy or proof that a project remains valid.
artifact_kinds.stale: On every list the service canonicalizes entries and freshly computes `ok`/`missing`; it de-duplicates older spelling/symlink aliases and never silently drops a moved/deleted location. Stored type/capabilities can be stale, so open/relocate re-resolve the target rather than trusting the record. Missing app-data falls back to in-memory registry for that process only.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: FileStudioProjectRegistry accepts only a JSON array; missing file means a fresh empty registry and malformed/non-array content is treated as empty so Studio startup continues. Registration/open/relocation accepts only a current ProjectTargetResolver-recognized project and canonicalizes real paths; unrecognized destinations are reported without registry mutation.
artifact_kinds.containment: The physical file is selected only by PokiePathResolver's platform app-data directory plus the fixed `projects.json` filename, never a project-controlled path. Project locations are converted to absolute realpaths where available; missing paths retain an absolute spelling until explicit relocate/remove, preventing relative/symlink aliases from creating duplicate identities.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Corrupt registry content yields an empty Projects list instead of crashing Studio; unrecognized register/open/relocate requests return `unrecognized` with canonical path. Missing project files remain visible with `missing` status so the author can diagnose rather than lose the entry.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Restart retains atomically written entries. Re-register/open a recognized project to refresh recency, use explicit relocate to replace a missing location while retaining its provenance, or remove an obsolete row. The next successful upsert/remove replaces malformed content with a valid array; if app-data is unavailable, restore it and restart/re-register to regain persistence.

artifact_kinds.label: Game package preparation recovery marker
artifact_kinds.shape: retry-only `<projectRoot>/.pokie-prepare-state.json` JSON companion containing the created manifest, created files and completed create/dependencies/build phases; it is removed after successful verify
artifact_kinds.provenance: The preparer writes its own manifest, created-file list and completed phase immediately after create, then updates it after dependency installation and build. Its presence is provenance that this exact directory is a partial preparer-owned scaffold, not that an arbitrary existing package is safe to alter.
artifact_kinds.stale: A marker is only meaningful for the retained scaffold and its last completed phase. Successful verify clears it. A manually moved, edited, stale or corrupt marker is never trusted as a generic project identity; unreadable JSON is treated as no marker.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only GamePackagePreparer consumes this private phase shape. Missing or corrupt state means start create normally, which retains the existing-directory safety guard rather than resuming or overwriting an unrelated directory.
artifact_kinds.containment: PreparationStateStore always joins the fixed hidden filename to the caller's projectRoot; it does not accept a marker path from package metadata or user content. The marker is a companion inside that scaffold, not an input selectable by another project/conversion workflow.
artifact_kinds.diagnostics: Failures in dependencies, build or verify preserve the marker and name the failed npm/verification phase with the same-directory retry action. Missing/corrupt state deliberately emits no parser failure; a non-preparer existing directory instead follows the create phase's already-exists protection.
artifact_kinds.recovery: Fix the underlying package failure and rerun preparation with the same parentDir/name; it resumes after the last completed phase. Do not copy a marker to claim ownership of another directory. A successful verification removes it; for an abandoned corrupt partial scaffold, repair/remove the scaffold deliberately and start fresh rather than treating the marker as a project artifact.

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: internal `<cacheDir>.lock` mutex directory and holder.json PID/token record; it serializes stale-cache eviction/publication and reclaims only abandoned holders, but is synchronization state rather than a cache artifact or user input
Studio UI destination enabled by a local project registry entry
the Stake-import operation, not a separate file: it consumes a Stake export and writes the separately inventoried Outcome Library plus config.json and optional source-provenance.json companions

legacy relationship label only; simulation replay uses the separately inventoried runtimeReplayDescriptor and, for native sources, its embedded exact outcome-source provenance rather than a second simulation-specific file

process-local StudioSimulationService/InMemoryStudioSimulationRepository job record: queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled state and completed report live only for the current Studio process and project; terminal retention evicts oldest records while active records remain
non_artifact_prerequisites.consumer: StudioServer report/detail/download routes and Simulation UI
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: records requested settings, project root and completed report provenance; restart, project change or eviction makes its id stale/unavailable

non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: unknown/evicted/different-project ids are 404; queued/running or failed/cancelled report requests are 409; cancellation is observed between chunks and retry submits a new job
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: poll/retry an active job, rerun a terminal failed/cancelled simulation, or start a new simulation after restart/eviction; no retained job is a project or conversion prerequisite

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: Studio HTTP Content-Disposition browser delivery envelope for the canonical simulationReport in JSON, Markdown or HTML; browser save location and persistence are user-controlled, not a POKIE project write
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: re-renders the completed job's canonical report with the same JSON/report renderers as CLI; it inherits the job/report source, seed and settings provenance and becomes historical when they do
non_artifact_prerequisites.compatibility: completed-only; JSON is the report, Markdown/HTML are renderings and none is a runnable project, conversion source or replay input
non_artifact_prerequisites.safety: buildSimulationReportDownload sanitizes game id, version and simulation id to [a-zA-Z0-9._-] for the attachment filename; server never selects a browser filesystem path
non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: invalid format is 400; unknown/evicted/different-project id is 404; queued/running/failed/cancelled-without-report is 409
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: wait/poll an active job, rerun a failed/cancelled job, or rerun after restart/eviction; only save a completed attachment if a durable user copy is wanted

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: process-local StudioReplayExecutionService/InMemoryStudioReplayRepository job record for queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled replay attempts; a completed record may hold the canonical runtimeReplayDescriptor
non_artifact_prerequisites.consumer: StudioServer replay/detail/download routes and Replay UI
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: records project, seed/round and completed replay provenance only in the current process; restart, project change or terminal-record eviction makes its id stale/unavailable
non_artifact_prerequisites.compatibility: only completed records with a descriptor can feed the canonical runtimeReplayDescriptor delivery envelope; package results remain best-effort
non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: unknown/evicted/different-project ids are 404; queued/running or failed/cancelled descriptor requests are 409; cancellation is chunk-boundary and retry creates a new job
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: poll/retry an active job, run again with the same parameters after failure/cancellation, or start a new replay after restart/eviction; this job state is never an input project

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: Studio HTTP Content-Disposition browser delivery envelope around the canonical runtimeReplayDescriptor; it does not create another replay artifact or a project/conversion prerequisite
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: copies a completed replay job's descriptor and inherits its exact native or best-effort package provenance; restart, project switch, failure, cancellation or eviction removes its server-side source
non_artifact_prerequisites.compatibility: completed-only JSON delivery; a downloaded descriptor may be pasted into Replay Artifact inspection, but the envelope itself is not a new replay identity
non_artifact_prerequisites.safety: buildReplayDownload supplies a sanitized game/version/replay-id attachment filename; server never writes a browser-selected path
non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: unknown/evicted/different-project id is 404; queued/running/failed/cancelled-without-descriptor is 409 and the UI keeps Download JSON disabled until exportReady
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: wait/poll, run again after failure/cancellation, or reproduce/recreate after restart/eviction; save the completed browser attachment separately if it is needed later

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: client-built Session Spin JSON Blob delivery envelope for the selected StudioRuntimeSessionView; it is a browser download of an already-recorded view, not a server replay descriptor
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: copies the selected process-local StudioRoundRecorder view including its session, studio round, timestamp and source provenance; it is stale/unavailable after the selected history entry is evicted, project changes or Studio restarts
non_artifact_prerequisites.compatibility: the blob is inspection output only: it does not create a runnable project, conversion prerequisite or canonical runtimeReplayDescriptor
non_artifact_prerequisites.safety: the client uses only the selected sessionId in a `spin-<sessionId>.json` suggested filename and the browser chooses the destination; no server filesystem path is written
non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: no selected/retained Session Spin leaves Download JSON unavailable; an empty recent-spins list is a valid state, and retrying a same request id reuses the recorded view rather than minting a competing entry
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: select another retained spin or play/reproduce a new round after history clear/eviction; retain a browser copy if the view must outlive Studio

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: CertificationTab process-local buildResult state used to inspect/export a completed Studio certification build; canonical certificationEvidenceBundle files remain on the selected output directory
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: holds the manifest/files returned by the selected build and is stale when the bundle/source/output selection changes or the browser tab reloads
non_artifact_prerequisites.compatibility: only a successful available buildResult enables manifest delivery; the state is not a certification verification result, project, conversion source or replay input
non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: without a buildResult the UI shows Build a certification bundle first and disables export; builder/source validation diagnostics remain attached to the build flow
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: repair the descriptor/source/output issue and build again, then inspect the durable evidence directory or download a fresh manifest

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: client-built certification manifest JSON Blob delivery envelope around the manifest already contained in certificationEvidenceBundle; it does not copy the sampled evidence directory into the browser
non_artifact_prerequisites.consumer: browser save dialog / certifier quick reference
non_artifact_prerequisites.provenance: serializes the current completed buildResult.manifest and inherits the bundle's game/library hashes, sampled evidence and validation provenance; it is historical after a rebuild/source change or unavailable after tab-state loss
non_artifact_prerequisites.compatibility: a manifest blob is a convenience reference, not the full certification bundle, a runnable project, conversion prerequisite or replay input; certifiers receive the durable directory for samples
non_artifact_prerequisites.safety: the client suggests a `certification-<game-id>-<version>-manifest.json` filename and the browser chooses the destination; it never writes a server/project path
non_artifact_prerequisites.diagnostics: Export is unavailable until buildResult exists; build/source errors must be repaired before a manifest can be regenerated
non_artifact_prerequisites.recovery: rebuild after repair or reload the durable bundle through its normal workflow, then download a fresh manifest; preserve the evidence directory rather than relying on the blob

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: advisory in-memory assessment of a tsPackage's Node API/dependency portability; it neither produces a WASM artifact nor grants a runtime/build capability
